findings.summary: ProcessorOptions is a 10-field bag threaded through SyncWorkflow → IWorkStrategy → IFileSyncOrchestrator where each layer uses a disjoint subset of fields
evidence: ProcessorOptions has 10 fields: branchName, workDir, configId, dryRun, retries, executor, prTemplate, noDelete, token, isGraphQLCommitMode
SyncWorkflow.execute() receives full ProcessorOptions, uses branchName/workDir/dryRun/retries/executor/prTemplate/token but passes the whole object to workStrategy.execute()
FileSyncStrategy.execute() receives full ProcessorOptions, passes it unchanged to fileSyncOrchestrator.sync()
FileSyncOrchestrator.sync() receives full ProcessorOptions but only uses workDir/configId/dryRun/noDelete/isGraphQLCommitMode — 5 of 10 fields
findings.suggestion: Split ProcessorOptions into layer-specific slices: a SyncWorkflowOptions (branchName, workDir, dryRun, retries, executor, prTemplate, token) and a FileSyncOptions (workDir, configId, dryRun, noDelete, isGraphQLCommitMode). Each layer receives only the fields it needs, and SyncWorkflow constructs FileSyncOptions from its own context rather than forwarding the full bag.

findings.summary: BranchSetupOptions bundles 10 fields including injected dependencies (gitOps, executor) alongside per-call data, creating a mixed-concern parameter object
evidence: BranchSetupOptions has 10 fields: repoInfo, branchName, baseBranch, workDir, isDirectMode, dryRun, retries, token, gitOps, executor
BranchManager constructor only takes ILogger; all 10 other dependencies arrive via setupBranch options bag including runtime collaborators gitOps and executor
SyncWorkflow.execute() manually assembles this 10-field object at line 66-77 from various local variables
findings.suggestion: Inject gitOps and executor via BranchManager constructor (they are per-session stable dependencies, not per-call data) and reduce BranchSetupOptions to the 8 per-call fields. Alternatively, split into BranchSetupDeps (gitOps, executor) and BranchSetupParams (the 8 data fields).

findings.summary: CommitPushOptions bundles 11 fields including injected dependencies (gitOps, executor) alongside per-call data
evidence: CommitPushOptions has 11 fields: repoInfo, gitOps, workDir, fileChanges, commitMessage, pushBranch, isDirectMode, dryRun, retries, token, executor
CommitPushManager constructor only takes ILogger; all other deps arrive via commitAndPush options
SyncWorkflow.execute() manually assembles this 11-field object at lines 96-108
findings.suggestion: Inject gitOps and executor via CommitPushManager constructor as stable session deps, reducing CommitPushOptions to the 9 per-call data fields.
